findings.title: Unknown model bypasses hard budget estimate
Unknown model cost never charged to budget
Multiline imports fake reproducer usage check
Empty file counted as one line
Unknown model estimated as free cost
findings.claim: estimateCost returns 0 for an unknown model instead of a worst-case upper bound, so the hard-budget gate in agents/index.mjs never blocks and Budget.charge (costOf returns null) never accrues, bypassing the spend cap.

findings.title: Multiline imports bypass used-symbol check
findings.claim: Body is built by deleting only single-line import statements, so a multi-line import leaves its named list and trailing from-line in the body. An imported symbol that is never used outside imports still matches the leftover text, so validateReproL0 incorrectly passes tests that never call repository code.

findings.title: Missing excerpts reported as present
findings.claim: isSnippetInExcerpts returns true when excerpts is not a string, asserting presence when there is no context to check against. Missing context should be false, otherwise a strong refute can be treated as in-context.

findings.title: Empty file counted as one line
findings.claim: Empty source splits to [""] with length 1 and does not end with newline, so lineCount computes as 1 instead of 0. Empty files are counted as 1 LOC and inflate repo LOC.
